# System Business Logic Reference (llms.txt)

The system orchestrates user authentication (including social OAuth), user management, budgeting and project governance, financial transactions, real-time notifications, and AI-driven budget recommendations. It is built on a layered, clean (hexagonal) architecture with clear domain models, use cases, ports, and adapters/persistence mappings, enabling pluggable external services (OAuth providers, email, Cloudinary, Gemini LLM, push notifications, Redis caches/queues) and robust auditability.

## Main data models and relationships
- Core entities & Domain Models
  - User, UserEntity, UserMapper
  - UserIncome, UserIncomeEntity, UserIncomeMapper
  - UserFinancialProfile, UserFinancialProfileEntity (holds demographic/spending profiles: LivingStatus, FamilyStatus, SpendingStyle, transport, etc.)
  - Project, ProjectEntity, ProjectMember, ProjectMemberEntity, ProjectHistory, ProjectHistoryEntity, ProjectTracking, ProjectTrackingEntity, ProjectContribution, ProjectContributionEntity
  - Budget, BudgetEntity, Transaction, TransactionEntity, TransactionDomainService
  - Notification, NotificationEntity, PushToken, PushTokenEntity
  - MessageRecord (representing processed job events/messages for stream processing)
- Associations
  - Project has many Budgets, Trackings, Contributions, Members; Members have Roles (and admin privileges)
  - User owns or participates in Projects; Users have Incomes, Financial Profiles, and Contributions
  - Budgets relate to Transactions and Project/Spend Categories; Settlements reconcile Budgets with Transactions
  - Notifications link to Recipients (Users) and persist with delivery metadata
- Persistence & mapping
  - Domain models map to persistence via Mapper classes (BudgetMapper, NotificationMapper, ProjectEntityMapper, UserIncomeMapper, UserMapper, TransactionMapper, PushTokenMapper, etc.)
  - Repositories: JpaBudgetRepository, JpaProjectRepository, JpaNotificationRepository, JpaUserFinancialProfileRepository, JpaUserIncomeRepository, JpaUserRepository, etc., with implementation classes (BudgetRepositoryImpl, UserRepositoryImpl, TransactionRepositoryImpl) implementing the domain interfaces.
- External & infrastructural boundaries
  - OAuth: ExternalOAuthPort/ExternalOAuthAdapter; providers (Facebook/Google) with dedicated config/properties
  - Media: CloudinaryPort implemented by CloudinaryService
  - Email: MailPort implemented by SmtpMailAdapter, configured via MailConfig/Properties
  - Push: PushTokenPort/PushTokenAdapter, PushNotificationSenderPort implemented by ExpoPushNotificationSender
  - AI/LLM: LlmPort implemented by GeminiLlmAdapter
  - Redis: CoreRedisConfig, AIRedisConfig; adapters include RedisJobCacheAdapter, RedisOtpCacheAdapter, RedisNotificationQueueAdapter, RedisInviteTokenAdapter, and RedisSettlementRetryAdapter
  - HTTP: RestClientConfig for external REST calls
  - Web: WebSocketConfig for real-time updates; WebSocketNotificationPublisher distributes alerts
- Security & verification
  - OTP/Verify: VerifyOtpRequest/VerifyOtpUseCase, VerifyEmail/OTP flows
  - Password flows: LoginRequest, RefreshTokenRequest, ResetPasswordRequest, SendResetPasswordOtpRequest
  - JWT Token generation and verification: Self-hosted JWT validation via SecurityConfig, AuthenticationFilter, and JwtTokenProvider, alongside SupabaseJwtValidator for third-party token validation.

## Key end-to-end workflows (high level)
- User onboarding and authentication
  - RegisterUseCase creates a new User, provisioning initial credentials; SendResetPasswordOtp/VerifyOtp handle validation
  - VerifyEmailUseCase activates accounts post-OTP verification
  - Social login flows via Facebook/Google: GoogleLoginUseCase/FacebookLoginUseCase orchestrate token validation, user provisioning, and session creation
  - RefreshTokenUseCase rotates tokens; old tokens are revoked and new ones are issued
  - UserProfile update flows let users modify their basic details or toggle notifications via UserNotificationUseCase
- User Financial Profile
  - Users create or update their UserFinancialProfile to store lifestyle settings (e.g. LivingStatus, IncomeLevel, SpendingStyle) used for personalized AI analysis
- Project lifecycle and budgeting
  - CreateProjectUseCase initializes a project with metadata, members, and budgets
  - CreateBudgetUseCase/CreateBulkBudgetsUseCase associate budgets with projects/categories
  - UpdateProjectUseCase and UpdateBudgetUseCase enforce history logging and state consistency
  - CreateProjectTrackingUseCase/UpdateProjectTrackingUseCase manage milestones/status and trigger alerts
- Financial operations and settlements
  - TransactionDomainService and TransactionMapper persist spending; transaction use cases handle CRUD and analytics filtering
  - Settlements run via MonthlySettlementScheduler, using SettlementEngine and PerformMonthlySettlementUseCase to reconcile project expenses, with Redis-backed retries orchestrated by RetryProjectContributionWorker.
  - SafeSpendingService calculates monthly safe spending limits to prevent overspending
- Notifications and communications
  - CreateNotificationUseCase generates content; NotificationService orchestrates routing to WebSocket (in-app) or push via Expo; NotificationWorker handles async processing
  - SmtpMailAdapter sends system emails (OTPs, alerts)

## Primary external dependencies and uses
- OAuth providers: FacebookOAuthProperties, GoogleOAuthConfig/Properties; social sign-in
- Media hosting: CloudinaryPort/CloudinaryService; profile pictures and media assets
- Email delivery: MailPort/SmtpMailAdapter; verifications, OTPs
- Push notifications: ExpoPushNotificationSender, PushTokenPort/PushTokenAdapter; mobile alerts
- AI/LLM: GeminiLlmAdapter, LlmPort; generates budget allocation plans and provides budget advisory recommendations
- JWT and auth: SupabaseJwtValidator/Properties; validation of Supabase JWTs
- Redis: CoreRedisConfig, AIRedisConfig with RedisJobCacheAdapter, RedisOtpCacheAdapter, RedisNotificationQueueAdapter, RedisInviteTokenAdapter, and RedisSettlementRetryAdapter; fast ephemeral storage, token caching, and retry job queues
- Web/HTTP: RestClientConfig for service connections, WebSocketConfig for notifications

## Dominant architectural patterns
- Clean/Hexagonal architecture: clear decoupling of domain models, domain repositories, use cases, ports, and adapters
- Layered separation: controllers (presentation) → use cases (application) → services (domain) → repositories (persistence) & adapters (infrastructure)
- Event-driven & async processing: JobQueuePort, JobAsyncService, Redis streams, and background Workers (NotificationWorker, ResultAIWorker, StreamReclaimJob, RetryProjectContributionWorker)
- Pluggable boundaries: external dependencies are accessed strictly through Port interfaces

## Domain modules (high-level guide)
- Auth & Identity
  - Entities/Models: User, UserEntity, ExternalOAuthUser
  - Use cases: LoginUseCase, RegisterUseCase, RefreshTokenUseCase, VerifyEmailUseCase, VerifyOtpUseCase, SendResetPasswordOtpUseCase, ResetPasswordUseCase, UpdateUserUseCase, UserNotificationUseCase
  - Adapters/Config: FacebookOAuthProperties, GoogleOAuthConfig/Properties, SupabaseJwtValidator, JwtTokenProvider, AuthenticationFilter, SecurityConfig
- User, Income & Profile
  - Models: UserIncome, UserIncomeEntity, UserFinancialProfile, UserFinancialProfileEntity
  - Use cases: CreateUserIncomeUseCase, UpdateUserIncomeUseCase, GetUserIncomeUseCase, DeleteUserIncomeUseCase, CreateUserFinancialProfileUseCase, UpdateUserFinancialProfileUseCase, GetUserFinancialProfileUseCase, GetUserFinancialProfileMeUseCase, DeleteUserFinancialProfileUseCase
- Projects & Governance
  - Models: Project, ProjectMember, ProjectHistory, ProjectTracking, ProjectContribution
  - Use cases: CreateProjectUseCase, UpdateProjectUseCase, DeleteProjectUseCase, GetProjectDetailUseCase, ListMyProjectsUseCase, InviteProjectMemberUseCase, AcceptProjectInviteUseCase, RemoveProjectMemberUseCase, SetProjectAdminUseCase, CreateProjectTrackingUseCase, UpdateProjectTrackingUseCase, GetProjectTrackingUseCase, DeleteProjectTrackingUseCase, AddProjectContributionUseCase, ListProjectContributionsUseCase, GetProjectContributionSummaryUseCase, ProjectBudgetAdvisorUseCase
- Budgeting & Finance
  - Models: Budget, BudgetEntity, Transaction, TransactionEntity, ProjectContributionEntity
  - Use cases: CreateBudgetUseCase, CreateBulkBudgetsUseCase, UpdateBudgetUseCase, DeleteBudgetUseCase, GetBudgetDetailUseCase, GetBudgetListUseCase, GenerateBudgetAllocationPlanUseCase
  - Domain Services: SafeSpendingService, SettlementEngine, TransactionDomainService
- Notifications & Communications
  - Models: Notification, PushToken
  - Use cases: CreateNotificationUseCase, GetNotificationUseCase
  - Services: NotificationService, PushTokenService
  - Adapters: SmtpMailAdapter, ExpoPushNotificationSender, WebSocketNotificationPublisher, RedisNotificationQueueAdapter
- Media & Assets
  - Use cases: GetImageUseCase, GenerateSignatureUseCase, DeleteImageUseCase
  - Services/Config: CloudinaryService, CloudinaryConfig
- Persistence & Mapping
  - Repositories: JpaUserRepository, JpaUserIncomeRepository, JpaUserFinancialProfileRepository, JpaProjectRepository, JpaBudgetRepository, JpaTransactionRepository, JpaNotificationRepository, JpaPushTokenRepository, JpaProjectContributionRepository
  - Mappers: UserMapper, UserIncomeMapper, ProjectEntityMapper, ProjectMemberMapper, ProjectHistoryMapper, ProjectTrackingMapper, ProjectContributionMapper, BudgetMapper, TransactionMapper, NotificationMapper, PushTokenMapper
- Infrastructure & Integrations
  - Workers/Jobs: NotificationWorker, ResultAIWorker, StreamReclaimJob, MonthlySettlementScheduler, RetryProjectContributionWorker
  - Config: JacksonConfig, SwaggerConfig, WebSocketConfig, RestClientConfig, AsyncConfig, DotenvConfig, ExecutorConfig

Closing note: The architecture deliberately separates domain rules (billing, access, verification, budget recommendations, and project governance) from infrastructure concerns (OAuth providers, email, media hosting, Redis, AI). This supports rapid evolution of either side while preserving correctness, auditability, and scalable collaboration.
